definitions.explanation: Red spots, bumps, or irritation that appear on the skin, usually as a symptom of illness, allergy, or other medical condition.

examples.japanese: {発疹|ほっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{発疹|ほっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Red spots appeared on my arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発疹|ほっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: After taking the medicine, a rash appeared all over my body, so I went to the hospital immediately.

notes:
Composed of {発|ほつ} (emit, develop) and {疹|しん} (rash). Can also be read はっしん, though ほっしん is more common in medical and everyday usage. The duplicate check flagged entry 20451 (⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧, transmission) as sharing the same kanji with a different reading — these are unrelated words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発疹|ほっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a rash appears
- {発疹|ほっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: a rash spreads
- ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{発疹|ほっしん}: allergic rash
- {薬疹|やくしん}: drug-induced rash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湿疹|しっしん}→湿疹：06951_shisshin⟧: eczema — a specific type of chronic or recurring skin inflammation
- ⟦かぶれ→かぶれ：25271_kabure⟧: rash from contact — typically caused by touching an irritant (plants, chemicals)
- ⟦{蕁麻疹|じんましん}→蕁麻疹：15182_jinmashin⟧: hives, urticaria — raised itchy welts, often from allergies
